name: Crescendo Harmonique
description: Compositeur de guerre improvisant des stratégies musicales adaptatives changeant de tactique au rythme des événements.

subject.archetype: Crescendo Harmonique — Chœur Synthétique Uncommon class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Crystalline armor plates growing naturally from body vibrating at resonant frequencies with visible sound waves emanating from every surface, each facet catching and fracturing light into rainbows, organic-metal hybrid construction
loadout.arsenal: Resonance tuning fork weapon humming at visible destructive frequency with air distortion around it, harmonic shield gauntlet generating visible ring-shaped sound wave barriers, crystalline conductor baton emitting visible vibration patterns The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting all_own, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Arms spread wide in open blessing with focused targeted golden healing wave expanding outward in all directions reaching every ally on battlefield simultaneously
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Violet Crystal
palette_names.role: primary_accent — resonance energy beams and crystal shards

palette_names.name: Silver Prismatic
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — sound wave visualization and reflections

palette_names.name: Deep Indigo
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — shockwave shadows and deep resonance tones

color_and_light.lighting_setup: oxidized copper frame with faction insignia embossed on each corner, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Slightly low angle waist-up shot with environmental action visible in background, motion blur on debris and effects

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield with crystal formations exploding from harmonic overload sending shards every direction, visible shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating cracked ceiling structures, entire environment vibrating at a frequency that makes air appear to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Expanding ring of pure restoration light passing through all friendlies simultaneously, each ally enveloped in golden light with wounds closing across entire field at same moment, Everywhere the wave passes environment blooms — grass sprouting, flowers opening, scorched ground recovering, massive wave of vitality transforming death into life across battlefield, Visible concentric sound waves expanding outward shattering nearby crystal structures into cascading shards, crystal fragments flying through air catching prismatic light, air visibly rippling and bending from sonic force, ground fracturing in geometric patterns from bass, floating debris suspended in harmonic stasis field
